verdict: Failed: one likely product bug (quantity not clamped to stock), one 403 block from the local server, and two page.goto timeouts that passed on retry; all on local Chrome only.

failures.test: Product info › quantity cannot go above the stock of the selected variant
failures.summary: After typing 99 and blurring, the quantity input keeps 99 instead of clamping to the Sage/S stock of 12, though the increase button does disable.
failures.evidence: Expected: "12" Received: "99" (24× resolved); snapshot: textbox "Quantity": "99", button "Increase quantity" [disabled], paragraph: 12 In Stock
failures.next_step: Check the quantity stepper's blur/change handler: it should clamp typed values to the selected variant's stock (12 for Sage/S). Also confirm that fill() plus blur() fires the event the component listens to.

failures.test: Product info › Add to Cart updates the header basket badge
failures.summary: The server returned a 403 security-policy block page instead of the product page, so the basket button never existed.
failures.evidence: lastNavigation status 403; snapshot: heading "Access denied" / "Your request was blocked by the security policy."
failures.next_step: Find what security policy or rate limiting the localhost:3100 server applies (WAF or bot middleware), allowlist the test runner or disable it for e2e, then rerun.

failures.test: Smoke: site health › home page renders with site chrome
failures.summary: The first page.goto to localhost:3100 hit the 30s load timeout and the retry passed.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded … waiting until "load"; outcome flaky, attempts 2
failures.next_step: Check whether the local server was still warming up or being throttled. Add a readiness wait before tests start, or wait for 'domcontentloaded' instead of 'load'.

failures.test: Product info › sizes that are out of stock for the colour are disabled
failures.summary: The beforeEach gotoProduct navigation timed out at 30s and the retry passed; the snapshot shows the page fully rendered.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded at productPage.gotoProduct (line 5); snapshot shows a full product page with status 200
failures.next_step: Look at slow-loading resources holding up the 'load' event on the product page (definition shows "Calculating delivery date"). Consider waitUntil 'domcontentloaded' in gotoProduct.
